payout_quote: 100% of approved articles are put up for sale in the marketplace — and each year, 85% of listed articles get sold. You can submit as many articles as you want, and when they sell you get paid on the 1st or 15th of the month.
steps: Join the Constant Content marketplace: create your profile (about 5 minutes), take the basic grammar quiz, and claim your spot.
Write articles on topics you choose and submit them per the guidelines.
Pass editorial review; approved articles are listed for sale in the marketplace.
Set your own prices; when an article sells, you get paid on the 1st or 15th of the month.
Optionally join a team writing for brands when editors invite you.
catches: Unsold articles earn nothing — the 85% annual sell-through rate is the platform's own figure, meaning ~15% never sell.
Editorial review gates everything: rejected articles cannot be listed.
Writing articles takes real time with no guaranteed sale — speculative effort.
Buyers set demand; niche topics you love may not sell.
Payment arrives on the platform's 1st/15th schedule, not instantly.
biggest_catch: Everything is speculative until a sale: you write full articles on your own time and only get paid if a buyer picks them up.
eligibility: Free marketplace account; must pass the grammar quiz and editorial review.
timing: Write and submit anytime; paid on the 1st or 15th when articles sell.
